mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declined for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the last month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates increased economic activity and potential for higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) coupled with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the last month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and economic activity increase.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases & PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreased and PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in the last two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as it indicates increased economic activity and potential for higher corporate earnings in related sectors.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in the last two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within the last month, coupled with a decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.1% in the same period, signals a potential easing of inflationary pressures and monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% & CPIAUCSL decreases > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreased by more than 0.25% and CPIAUCSL decreased by more than 0.1% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to rise.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increased for two consecutive months.
